prompt.en: Which word means "a place where you buy food and other goods"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word means "a place where you buy food and other goods"?

explain.en: A market is a place to buy and sell goods. The other places provide treatment, books or sport.
explain.zh: Market 是买卖物品的市场；其他选项分别是医院、图书馆和体育场。

prompt.en: Which word means "a young dog"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word means "a young dog"?

explain.en: A baby dog is a puppy; a kitten is a baby cat.
explain.zh: Puppy 是小狗；kitten 是小猫，不能混淆。

prompt.en: Which word means "the first meal of the day"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word means "the first meal of the day"?

explain.en: Breakfast is the meal eaten at the start of the day, usually in the morning.
explain.zh: Breakfast 是一天开始时吃的早餐；lunch 是午餐，dinner 是晚餐。

prompt.en: Which word means "a person who teaches students"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word means "a person who teaches students"?

explain.en: A teacher helps pupils learn; the other jobs are not defined by teaching pupils.
explain.zh: Teacher 指教导学生的人；其他职业不以教学生为主要工作。

prompt.en: Which word means "a building where books are kept for people to read or borrow"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word means "a building where books are kept for people to read or borrow"?

explain.en: A library keeps books for people to read or borrow and return.
explain.zh: Library 是让人阅读或借还书籍的图书馆。

prompt.en: Which word means "not heavy"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word means "not heavy"?

explain.en: Light can describe weight as well as brightness. Here it means not heavy.
explain.zh: Light 既可描述光线，也可描述重量；这里的意思是“轻的”。

prompt.en: Which word means "a place where sick people are treated"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word means "a place where sick people are treated"?

explain.en: A hospital provides care and treatment for people who are ill.
explain.zh: Hospital 是为病人提供护理和治疗的医院。

prompt.en: Which word means "willing to give freely"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word means "willing to give freely"?

explain.en: Generous describes someone happy to share or give to others.
explain.zh: Generous 表示慷慨，愿意与别人分享或给予。

prompt.en: Which word means "careful about danger"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word means "careful about danger"?

explain.en: Cautious means taking care to avoid danger; careless means not taking care.
explain.zh: Cautious 表示小心谨慎、注意危险；careless 表示粗心。

prompt.en: Which word means "a strong feeling of wanting to know something"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word means "a strong feeling of wanting to know something"?

explain.en: Curiosity is the desire to find out or learn more about something.
explain.zh: Curiosity 是好奇心，即想知道或了解更多的心情。

prompt.en: Which word is closest in meaning to "happy"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word is closest in meaning to "happy"?

explain.en: Glad and happy both describe a pleased feeling.
explain.zh: Glad 和 happy 都表示高兴的心情。

prompt.en: Which word is closest in meaning to "big"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word is closest in meaning to "big"?

explain.en: Large and big both describe a great size.
explain.zh: Large 和 big 都用来形容体积或规模大。

prompt.en: Which word is closest in meaning to "fast"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word is closest in meaning to "fast"?

explain.en: Quick and fast both describe moving or doing something at speed.
explain.zh: Quick 和 fast 都可以表示速度快。

prompt.en: Which word is closest in meaning to "begin"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word is closest in meaning to "begin"?

explain.en: Begin and start both mean to do the first part of an activity.
explain.zh: Begin 和 start 都表示开始做某件事。

prompt.en: Which word is closest in meaning to "smart"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word is closest in meaning to "smart"?

explain.en: Smart can mean clever: able to understand or learn things well.
explain.zh: Smart 在这里表示聪明，与 clever 意思最接近。

prompt.en: Which word is closest in meaning to "afraid"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word is closest in meaning to "afraid"?

explain.en: Afraid and scared both describe feeling fear.
explain.zh: Afraid 和 scared 都表示害怕。

prompt.en: Which word is closest in meaning to "pretty"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word is closest in meaning to "pretty"?

explain.en: Pretty and beautiful both describe something pleasant to look at.
explain.zh: Pretty 和 beautiful 都可以形容外表好看。

prompt.en: Which word is closest in meaning to "enormous"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word is closest in meaning to "enormous"?

explain.en: Enormous and huge both mean very large; tiny means very small.
explain.zh: Enormous 和 huge 都表示巨大；tiny 则表示非常小。

prompt.en: Which word is closest in meaning to "assist"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word is closest in meaning to "assist"?

explain.en: Assist means to help someone do something.
explain.zh: Assist 表示协助别人，与 help 意思最接近。

prompt.en: Which word is closest in meaning to "brave"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which word is closest in meaning to "brave"?

explain.en: Courageous and brave describe facing fear or difficulty with courage.
explain.zh: Courageous 和 brave 都表示勇敢面对害怕或困难的情况。

prompt.en: What is the opposite of "hot"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What is the opposite of "hot"?

explain.en: Cold describes a low temperature, the opposite of hot.
explain.zh: Cold 表示温度低，与 hot（热的）相反。

prompt.en: What is the opposite of "big"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What is the opposite of "big"?

explain.en: Small describes a little size, the opposite of big.
explain.zh: Small 表示体积小，与 big 相反。

prompt.en: What is the opposite of "fast"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What is the opposite of "fast"?

explain.en: Slow describes low speed, the opposite of fast.
explain.zh: Slow 表示速度慢，与 fast 相反。

prompt.en: What is the opposite of "happy"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What is the opposite of "happy"?

explain.en: Sad describes an unhappy feeling, the opposite of happy.
explain.zh: Sad 表示难过，与 happy 的高兴心情相反。

prompt.en: What is the opposite of "open"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What is the opposite of "open"?

explain.en: A closed door is not open. Closed is the opposite of open here.
explain.zh: Closed 表示关闭的，与 open（打开的）相反。

prompt.en: What is the opposite of "clean"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What is the opposite of "clean"?

explain.en: Dirty means not clean, often because of dust or mud.
explain.zh: Dirty 表示脏的，例如沾了灰尘或泥土，与 clean 相反。

prompt.en: What is the opposite of "strong"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What is the opposite of "strong"?

explain.en: Weak means lacking strength; it is the opposite of strong.
explain.zh: Weak 表示力气不足，与 strong（强壮的）相反。

prompt.en: What is the opposite of "difficult"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What is the opposite of "difficult"?

explain.en: Easy means not difficult. Hard, complex and tough suggest difficulty.
explain.zh: Easy 表示容易；hard、complex 和 tough 都表示有难度。

prompt.en: What is the opposite of "ancient"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What is the opposite of "ancient"?

explain.en: Ancient refers to the very distant past; modern relates to more recent times.
explain.zh: Ancient 表示古老的；modern 表示现代的，时间概念相反。

prompt.en: What is the opposite of "generous"?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What is the opposite of "generous"?

explain.en: Stingy describes being unwilling to share or give, the opposite of generous.
explain.zh: Stingy 表示吝啬、不愿给予，与 generous（慷慨的）相反。

prompt.en: Which word is NOT a fruit?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Which word is NOT a fruit?

explain.en: Carrot is a root vegetable. Apple, banana and mango are fruits.
explain.zh: Carrot 是根菜类；apple、banana 和 mango 都是水果。

prompt.en: Which word is NOT an animal?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Which word is NOT an animal?

explain.en: Sofa is furniture for sitting on. Lion, tiger and elephant are animals.
explain.zh: Sofa 是用来坐的家具；另外三个词都是动物名称。

prompt.en: Which word is NOT an item of stationery?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Which word is NOT an item of stationery?

explain.en: Banana is a fruit. Pencil, ruler and eraser are stationery used for schoolwork.
explain.zh: Banana 是水果；pencil、ruler 和 eraser 都是学习用的文具。

prompt.en: Which word is NOT a vehicle?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Which word is NOT a vehicle?

explain.en: A chair is furniture. A bus, train and car are vehicles used for travel.
explain.zh: Chair 是家具；bus、train 和 car 是交通工具。

prompt.en: Which word is NOT a colour?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Which word is NOT a colour?

explain.en: Happy names a feeling. Red, blue and green name colours.
explain.zh: Happy 表示心情；red、blue 和 green 都是颜色。

prompt.en: Which word is NOT a word naming a family relationship?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Which word is NOT a word naming a family relationship?

explain.en: Teacher names a job. Mother, father and sister name family relationships.
explain.zh: Teacher 是职业名称；mother、father 和 sister 是亲属关系名称。

prompt.en: Which word is NOT a day of the week?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Which word is NOT a day of the week?

explain.en: January is a month. Monday, Tuesday and Friday are days of the week.
explain.zh: January 是月份名称；另外三个词都是星期几。

prompt.en: A poster lists activities pupils can play: football, basketball and badminton. Which word names a place, rather than a sport?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A poster lists activities pupils can play: football, basketball and badminton. Which word names a place, rather than a sport?

explain.en: Library names a place for books; football, basketball and badminton name sports.
explain.zh: Library 是图书馆，属于地点；其余三个词是运动项目。

prompt.en: Whales, dolphins and sharks live in the sea. Which word names a bird instead of one of these sea animals?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Whales, dolphins and sharks live in the sea. Which word names a bird instead of one of these sea animals?

explain.en: An eagle is a bird. The passage groups the other three animals by their sea habitat.
explain.zh: Eagle 是鸟类；题目把另外三种动物按海洋栖息地分在一组。

prompt.en: A maths worksheet asks for names of flat shapes. Which word belongs in a list of fruits instead?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A maths worksheet asks for names of flat shapes. Which word belongs in a list of fruits instead?

explain.en: Orange names a fruit here; triangle, square and circle name flat shapes.
explain.zh: Orange 在这里是水果；triangle、square 和 circle 是平面图形名称。

prompt.en: "___ your bed every morning."
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。"___ your bed every morning."

explain.en: Make your bed means arrange the sheets and covers neatly after sleeping.
explain.zh: Make your bed 是整理床铺的固定说法，不是制造一张床。

prompt.en: "___ the dishes after dinner."
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。"___ the dishes after dinner."

explain.en: Do the dishes means wash the plates, bowls and other dishes.
explain.zh: Do the dishes 是洗碗碟的常用搭配。

prompt.en: "___ a photo of the sunset."
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。"___ a photo of the sunset."

explain.en: Take a photo is the usual phrase for using a camera to make a picture.
explain.zh: 用相机拍照的常用搭配是 take a photo。

prompt.en: Choose the word meaning eat: "___ breakfast before school."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the word meaning eat: "___ breakfast before school."

explain.en: Have breakfast means eat breakfast; the question asks specifically for this meaning.
explain.zh: Have breakfast 表示吃早餐，符合题目指定的 eat 的意思。

prompt.en: Choose the usual phrase: "Try not to ___ a mistake in the test."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the usual phrase: "Try not to ___ a mistake in the test."

explain.en: Make a mistake means do something incorrectly. Try not to tells us to avoid it.
explain.zh: Make a mistake 表示犯错；try not to 表示尽量避免犯错。

prompt.en: "___ your best in the competition."
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。"___ your best in the competition."

explain.en: Do your best means try as hard as you can.
explain.zh: Do your best 表示尽自己最大的努力。

prompt.en: "___ a shower before bed."
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。"___ a shower before bed."

explain.en: Take a shower is a usual phrase for washing under a shower.
explain.zh: Take a shower 是淋浴的常用说法。

prompt.en: "___ a rest after playing football."
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。"___ a rest after playing football."

explain.en: Have a rest means stop an activity for a short time to recover energy.
explain.zh: Have a rest 表示休息一下，让自己恢复精神。

prompt.en: "___ attention in class."
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。"___ attention in class."

explain.en: Pay attention means listen or look carefully and concentrate.
explain.zh: Pay attention 表示专心留意、认真听或看。

prompt.en: "___ care of your younger sibling."
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。"___ care of your younger sibling."

explain.en: Take care of means look after and help keep someone safe and well.
explain.zh: Take care of 表示照顾某人。

prompt.en: What do we call a market with stalls selling fresh fish, meat and vegetables?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。What do we call a market with stalls selling fresh fish, meat and vegetables?

explain.en: A wet market has stalls selling fresh food such as fish, meat and vegetables.
explain.zh: Wet market 指售卖鲜鱼、肉类和蔬菜等食物的巴刹。

prompt.en: "Nasi lemak" is a Malaysian ___.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。"Nasi lemak" is a Malaysian ___.

explain.en: Nasi lemak is a prepared rice dish; it is not a fruit, drink or vegetable.
explain.zh: Nasi lemak（椰浆饭）是一种米饭料理，不是水果、饮料或蔬菜。

prompt.en: Read the description: "This large wild cat has orange fur with black stripes." Which animal is described?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Read the description: "This large wild cat has orange fur with black stripes." Which animal is described?

explain.en: Orange fur and black stripes are the clues describing a tiger.
explain.zh: 橙色皮毛和黑色条纹是辨认 tiger（老虎）的线索。

prompt.en: What do you call your father's brother?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What do you call your father's brother?

explain.en: Your father's brother is your uncle. Aunt is used for a female relative of that generation.
explain.zh: 父亲的兄弟用 uncle；aunt 用于同辈的女性亲属。

prompt.en: A sign points to the way out of the school hall. Which word should be on the sign?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A sign points to the way out of the school hall. Which word should be on the sign?

explain.en: Exit means the way out. Entrance means the way in.
explain.zh: Exit 表示出口；entrance 表示入口。

prompt.en: At a fruit stall, Mei reads: "Durian: a large fruit with a spiky shell." What does spiky mean?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。At a fruit stall, Mei reads: "Durian: a large fruit with a spiky shell." What does spiky mean?

explain.en: Spiky means having sharp points. The shell description supplies the clue.
explain.zh: Spiky 表示有尖刺的；题目用榴梿外壳的描述提供线索。

prompt.en: What do you call the place in school where students eat during recess?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What do you call the place in school where students eat during recess?

explain.en: A canteen is the school eating place, especially during recess.
explain.zh: Canteen 是学校里学生下课时用餐的食堂。

prompt.en: The family left the busy city for a kampung with a few houses and farms. Which English word best describes this small settlement?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The family left the busy city for a kampung with a few houses and farms. Which English word best describes this small settlement?

explain.en: Village describes a small settlement with homes, unlike a large busy city.
explain.zh: Village 表示村庄，符合房屋少、靠近农地的小聚落描述。

prompt.en: What do we call a small neighbourhood shop that sells daily necessities and snacks?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。What do we call a small neighbourhood shop that sells daily necessities and snacks?

explain.en: A sundry shop is a small shop selling a range of everyday items.
explain.zh: Sundry shop 是售卖各种日用品的小杂货店。

prompt.en: The neighbours gathered for food, games and songs to mark a happy occasion. This event was a ___.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The neighbours gathered for food, games and songs to mark a happy occasion. This event was a ___.

explain.en: Celebration names an event for a happy or special occasion; food, games and songs support that meaning.
explain.zh: Celebration 表示庆祝活动；食物、游戏、歌曲和开心的场合提供了线索。

prompt.en: The pupil put the letter in an envelope and stuck a ___ on it before posting it.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The pupil put the letter in an envelope and stuck a ___ on it before posting it.

explain.en: A stamp shows that postage has been paid. An envelope and posting are the clues.
explain.zh: Stamp 是邮票；信封和寄信这两个线索说明应选邮票。

prompt.en: At the clinic, the nurse asked the patients to sit in the ___ room until their names were called.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。At the clinic, the nurse asked the patients to sit in the ___ room until their names were called.

explain.en: People wait to be called in a waiting room; the clinic context supports this phrase.
explain.zh: 候诊的地方称为 waiting room；题目说等候叫到名字。

prompt.en: "The bag is light, so Hana can carry it easily." What does light mean here?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"The bag is light, so Hana can carry it easily." What does light mean here?

explain.en: Carrying the bag easily is a clue about its weight, not brightness or colour.
explain.zh: 能轻松提起书包说明这里谈重量，因此 light 表示轻。

prompt.en: "Turn right after the bridge." Which sentence uses right with the same meaning?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"Turn right after the bridge." Which sentence uses right with the same meaning?

choices: The shop is on your right.
It is right to be kind.
You have the right to ask.
questions.answer: The shop is on your right.

explain.en: Both the instruction and the shop sentence use right as a direction.
explain.zh: 两句中的 right 都表示右边的方向；其余句子表示正确、合宜或权利。

prompt.en: "The pupils watched a bat fly from the cave." Which clue shows that bat is an animal here?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"The pupils watched a bat fly from the cave." Which clue shows that bat is an animal here?

choices: It can fly from a cave.
questions.answer: It can fly from a cave.

explain.en: Fly from the cave describes an animal's action; a sports bat cannot fly by itself.
explain.zh: 从洞里飞出来是动物的动作；球棒不能自行飞行。

prompt.en: A notice says, "Please return all borrowed books by Friday." Which word means give back?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A notice says, "Please return all borrowed books by Friday." Which word means give back?

explain.en: Return means give something back; borrow means take it temporarily.
explain.zh: Return 表示归还；borrow 是借来暂时使用。

prompt.en: "The path was narrow, so the pupils walked one behind another." Which word is closest to narrow?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"The path was narrow, so the pupils walked one behind another." Which word is closest to narrow?

explain.en: Walking in single file suggests there is little space across the path: not wide.
explain.zh: 学生必须一个跟着一个走，说明路面不宽；narrow 表示狭窄。

prompt.en: "The hall was silent during the story." Which word would change the sentence to the opposite meaning?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"The hall was silent during the story." Which word would change the sentence to the opposite meaning?

explain.en: Noisy means full of sound, the opposite of silent. The other choices suggest quietness.
explain.zh: Noisy 表示吵闹，与 silent（安静无声的）相反；其他选项都接近安静。

prompt.en: "Aina was relieved when she found her missing bus card." How did she most likely feel?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"Aina was relieved when she found her missing bus card." How did she most likely feel?

explain.en: Finding the missing card removes the worry. Relieved means less anxious after a problem ends.
explain.zh: 找到遗失的车卡后不再担心；relieved 表示松了一口气。

prompt.en: "Please handle this glass model carefully. It is fragile." Which instruction has the same meaning?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"Please handle this glass model carefully. It is fragile." Which instruction has the same meaning?

choices: Be gentle because it breaks easily.
Hurry because it is very heavy.
Shake it because it is noisy.
Hide it because it is bright.
questions.answer: Be gentle because it breaks easily.

explain.en: Fragile means easily broken; handle carefully tells us to be gentle.
explain.zh: Fragile 表示易碎；handle carefully 提醒我们轻拿轻放。

prompt.en: The word reuse means use again. Which action shows reuse?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The word reuse means use again. Which action shows reuse?

choices: Using an empty jar to store pencils.
Throwing a jar into the rubbish bin.
Buying a new jar each morning.
Breaking a jar into tiny pieces.
questions.answer: Using an empty jar to store pencils.

explain.en: Re- can mean again. The same jar is used again for a new purpose.
explain.zh: 前缀 re- 可表示“再一次”；把同一个空罐子拿来放铅笔，就是再次使用。

prompt.en: Which word completes the sentence? "The answer was correct before, but now the pupil thinks it is ___."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Which word completes the sentence? "The answer was correct before, but now the pupil thinks it is ___."

explain.en: Incorrect is an adjective meaning not correct; the prefix in- changes the meaning.
explain.zh: Incorrect 是形容词，表示不正确；前缀 in- 在这里表示否定。

prompt.en: "Be helpful when your classmates need you." What does helpful mean?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"Be helpful when your classmates need you." What does helpful mean?

explain.en: Helpful describes someone willing to help; -ful can mean having a quality.
explain.zh: Helpful 形容愿意帮助人的人；-ful 可表示具有某种特质。

prompt.en: The teacher says, "Put the words in alphabetical order." Which list is correct?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The teacher says, "Put the words in alphabetical order." Which list is correct?

explain.en: All start with b. Compare the next letters: a, e, i, o.
explain.zh: 四个词都以 b 开头，再比较第二个字母：a、e、i、o。

prompt.en: A dictionary page has the guide words market and meal. Which word would be between them alphabetically?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A dictionary page has the guide words market and meal. Which word would be between them alphabetically?

explain.en: Mat comes after market because t comes after r, and before meal because a comes before e.
explain.zh: Mat 在 market 之后，因为第三个字母 t 排在 r 后；又在 meal 之前，因为第二个字母 a 排在 e 前。

prompt.en: Choose the spelling that fits: "We can ___ the school bell from the field."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the spelling that fits: "We can ___ the school bell from the field."

explain.en: Hear is the verb for noticing sound. Here refers to a place.
explain.zh: Hear 表示听见声音；here 表示这里，两者发音相同但意思不同。

prompt.en: Choose the word that fits: "Please ___ your name at the top of the page."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the word that fits: "Please ___ your name at the top of the page."

explain.en: Write means form letters or words. Right has a different meaning despite the same sound.
explain.zh: Write 表示书写；right 虽然发音相同，却不是写字的意思。

prompt.en: "Ravi lent Mei his ruler. Mei will give it back after class." What did Ravi do?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"Ravi lent Mei his ruler. Mei will give it back after class." What did Ravi do?

choices: Let Mei use his ruler for a short time.
Asked Mei to buy a ruler.
questions.answer: Let Mei use his ruler for a short time.

explain.en: Lent means allowed someone to borrow. The promise to give it back shows it is temporary.
explain.zh: Lent 是 lend 的过去式，表示借出；会归还说明只是暂时使用。

prompt.en: "The bus was delayed by heavy rain." What does delayed mean?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"The bus was delayed by heavy rain." What does delayed mean?

explain.en: Delayed describes something happening later than expected; it is about time.
explain.zh: Delayed 表示延误、比原定时间迟，谈的是时间而非大小或价格。

prompt.en: The pupils joined a queue at the canteen. What should a new pupil joining the queue do?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The pupils joined a queue at the canteen. What should a new pupil joining the queue do?

choices: Stand at the back of the line.
Move to the front without asking.
questions.answer: Stand at the back of the line.

explain.en: A queue is a line of people waiting for their turn; new arrivals join its back.
explain.zh: Queue 是等候轮到自己的队伍；新来的人应排在队尾。

prompt.en: "The class donated storybooks to a reading corner." Which word is closest to donated?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"The class donated storybooks to a reading corner." Which word is closest to donated?

explain.en: Donated means gave something to help others without asking for payment.
explain.zh: Donated 表示捐赠，即不要求报酬地把东西送出帮助别人。

prompt.en: "Please keep the corridor clear." Which action best follows this instruction?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"Please keep the corridor clear." Which action best follows this instruction?

choices: Move the bags away so people can walk through.
Place more chairs across the walkway.
Paint every bag the same colour.
questions.answer: Move the bags away so people can walk through.

explain.en: Clear here means free from objects that block the way. It is about keeping a path open.
explain.zh: Clear 在这里表示没有障碍物；把书包移开，走廊才能通行。

prompt.en: A recipe says, "Stir the soup gently." What should the cook do?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A recipe says, "Stir the soup gently." What should the cook do?

choices: Move a spoon slowly around in the soup.
Throw the soup onto a plate.
Leave the spoon outside the bowl.
Pour the soup onto the floor.
questions.answer: Move a spoon slowly around in the soup.

explain.en: Stir means move a spoon around in a liquid to mix it. Gently means without force.
explain.zh: Stir 表示用汤匙搅拌液体；gently 表示轻轻地。

prompt.en: "The lost child felt safe when a teacher stayed beside her." Which word is the opposite of safe in this context?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"The lost child felt safe when a teacher stayed beside her." Which word is the opposite of safe in this context?

explain.en: Safe means protected from harm; in danger gives the opposite meaning.
explain.zh: Safe 表示安全、受到保护；in danger 表示处于危险之中，意思相反。

prompt.en: "The pupils explored the garden and discovered a tiny nest." Which word is closest to discovered?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"The pupils explored the garden and discovered a tiny nest." Which word is closest to discovered?

explain.en: Discovered means found or learned about something for the first time; the pupils did not build the nest.
explain.zh: Discovered 表示发现原先不知道的东西；学生是发现鸟巢，不是筑巢。

prompt.en: "Rina kept practising even after several mistakes." Which word best describes her effort?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"Rina kept practising even after several mistakes." Which word best describes her effort?

explain.en: Continuing despite mistakes shows determination: a strong wish to keep trying.
explain.zh: 犯错后仍继续练习，表现出坚定、不轻易放弃的态度，因此选 determined。

prompt.en: "The timetable was changed. The new time is 10 a.m." Which word is closest to timetable?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"The timetable was changed. The new time is 10 a.m." Which word is closest to timetable?

explain.en: A timetable or schedule lists when activities happen. The new time is the clue.
explain.zh: Timetable 和 schedule 都表示时间表；题目提到新的活动时间。

prompt.en: A shop notice says, "Keep your receipt if you want to exchange an item." What is a receipt?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A shop notice says, "Keep your receipt if you want to exchange an item." What is a receipt?

choices: A record showing what you paid for.
A list of words and meanings.
questions.answer: A record showing what you paid for.

explain.en: A receipt records a purchase and payment, so it can help show where an item was bought.
explain.zh: Receipt 是收据，记录所购物品和付款情况，可用来证明购买。

prompt.en: "The instructions were clear, so everyone knew what to do." What does clear mean here?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"The instructions were clear, so everyone knew what to do." What does clear mean here?

explain.en: Knowing what to do is a clue that the instructions were easy to understand.
explain.zh: 人人都明白该做什么，说明 clear 在这里表示清楚易懂，不是透明或晴朗。

prompt.en: "The pupils will set up a reading corner." What does set up mean here?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"The pupils will set up a reading corner." What does set up mean here?

choices: Prepare and arrange it for use.
Carry it high into the air.
Close it for the whole year.
questions.answer: Prepare and arrange it for use.

explain.en: Set up means prepare something so people can use it, such as arranging books and seats.
explain.zh: Set up 在这里表示布置和建立，例如安排书籍与座位，让阅读角可供使用。
